snippet.title: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault - Exclusive Developer Interview - FGS Live From Los Angeles
snippet.description:
An exclusive interview with the developers of Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault, detailing some of the new mechanics and intriguing updates to the highly-anticipated RPG-come-shop management game. Live the double life of a fearless adventurer and a crafty merchant when Moonlighter 2 comes to PC this Summer. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #moonlighter2
